description: Read the price grid for ENERGY or BANDWIDTH: `prices[i][j]` is the unit price in SUN for `amounts[i]` resource units rented for `durations[j]` (e.g. '15m', '1h', '1d'). Durations of 1 day or longer are priced per day: '30d' at 40 SUN costs 40 x 30 SUN per unit in total. Use to compare cost across amounts and durations in one call; use `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource` for an exact quote. Public, read-only.

address.description: Optional receiver address; prices can depend on the account.

name: tronsave_get_price_table
title: Resource Price Table
